style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the crab stays put, whole body working every beat; foam, spray and pebbles whizz by camera nonstop; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the crab fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the crab: hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, wide toothy grin, lives inside it, until 6.4 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff
props: ONE piggy bank; ONE sheet with the single Russian word ШТРАФ in big black letters; A SWARM of tiny crabs
environment: rocky sea edge at low tide: wet ochre boulders with deep cracks, breaking waves, wet sand

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.7 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus'. o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: first word at 0.35; 0.35-6.4 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 6.4 not a word, sfx go on

timeline.a: a wave bursts on the boulders; the crab in the piggy bank rears up at the waterline, thrusting eyestalks and claw into the lens, filling the frame; ONE eye blinks in the slot
the crab sinks low in the piggy bank, head and mouthparts out, eyestalks flattening, the bank rocking; A SWARM of tiny crabs streams past the lens
timeline.c: sand level, crabs streaming in the foreground beside him

timeline.a: he pops out and shuffles sideways on the spot, legs a blur, eyestalks swivelling apart; a rolling shell tumbles in with the foam
he rears up on his back legs, claw raised, eyestalks bending down to the slot; the slot eye blinks twice up at him
timeline.c: high over the bank, slot in the foreground

timeline.a: he spins on the spot chasing the slot on his back, sand fanning out; the crab swarm flees the wave in the foreground, diving into cracks
he leaps and slams shell-first onto the sand, legs kicking, claw drumming the ceramic; a wave crashes on the boulder behind
timeline.c: from atop the boulder, spray in the foreground

timeline.a: ONE cuffed tentacle shoots out of the slot and whips the sand; the piggy bank rockets up, the crab flung out tumbling head over tail, pale tail end bare, legs flailing
timeline.c: camera hurls itself down off the boulder

timeline.a: the spinning piggy bank drops from the sky into the lens, filling the frame, slot eye winking, then thuds upright; behind it the crab lands on his back, legs pedalling
the octopus squeezes out and flings ONE ШТРАФ sheet; it slaps over the crab, who rolls across the sand wrapped in it
a wave smashes the boulder, the crab swarm scattering into cracks; the octopus slaps the piggy bank, waves his cap; the crab cartwheels out of the foam, ШТРАФ sheet flapping in his claws

the crab wears the ШТРАФ sheet wrapped flat round his tail end like a shell and rears up into the lens, word ШТРАФ flat to the lens, filling the frame; a wave sweeps up the bank behind, the octopus ducking into the slot

must_appear: eyestalks 0.0, bank into lens 7.0, crab in ШТРАФ sheet 9.1
negative_prompt: microphone, extra octopus, slow motion, any spoken word after 6.4, accented Russian, any other text, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, duplicate props, floating objects, zoom, night, cut, scene change
